mismatch: The two entries do not match.
keepSafe: Keep it somewhere safe: PidiElf does not store it anywhere and cannot remind you of it.

advice.common: too common, it would be guessed at once
advice.short: make it longer: a phrase of a few words works wonders

honest: Only the password to open is enforced by encryption. Restrictions are honoured by well-behaved PDF readers, but they are not strong protection: anyone who can open the file can get around them with other software.
ownerHint: It lets you change or lift the restrictions later. It must differ from the password to open.
ownerRandom: If left empty, PidiElf draws a random one that it neither shows nor keeps: the restrictions can then no longer be lifted that way. The password to open will still open the file.
ownerSame: The owner password must differ from the password to open: otherwise opening the file would grant every right.
needPassword: Enter a password to open the file.
needConfirmation: Confirm the password by typing it a second time.
summary: The file will be encrypted with 256-bit AES.
note: 256-bit AES encryption. Keep the password safe: without it the file can no longer be opened, and nobody can recover it for you.
previewOpen: The password will be asked every time the file is opened. Content encrypted with 256-bit AES.

copy.off: Copying text and images not allowed
